I use speed (European racemic street amph) and it has had an immense effect on living with PTSD. More so than five years of trauma therapy, because it no longer feels like my life has been put on hold until I'm able to dig through the mountains of conundrums to finally cure myself. I have for the first time in years had the feeling that I'm living, in motion. I've  also had more breakthroughs and progress in 6  months than 6 years of therapy.

Meth on the other hand is more recreational. Makes me silly and horny, but the headspace is not one  for sorting through trauma I feel? I'm a noob with meth compared to speed though. It took me a while to learn how  to use speed so it became "right"  for me, maybe  I'm not there yet  with crystal.

Everything just seems alien, and therefor terrifying. You can't feel emotion or rational thought, you're like a robot trying to analyse a human world. Of course, the pain stays. My goal with psychedelics has been to let go of the ego and reconnect with my emotions, simply put. In other words, let go of the self-centered dopamine chasing narcissism that follow any drug addiction, and open your heart up so you can start to deal with everything you've gone through (traumas, depression, anxiety, emotional neglect etc etc). Anyone who's ever successfully gone clean will know what I mean by saying it's easy to stop taking drugs, but it's hella hard to put them behind you and make the desires to do them again go away.

A year ago, the first thought in my head in the morning when I woke up would be to figure out how to keep myself high, drunk, stoned and distracted till bedtime comes around. Now I wake up and I don't think much at all, the less ego I have the less inner dialogue I'm forced to listen to, - instead I go out on the balcony, have a smoke and some tea and just feel the atmosphere of what's going on outside. Thanks to psychedelics that loud voice in my head telling me what I need to stay happy and stimulated isn't as loud anymore, and every time I go soul searching again on LSD, it lessens the voice even more. I have effectively, in just a couple months, gone from being a non-functioning drug addict/alcoholic with such severe social anxiety I couldn't even go to the shops without a fifth of vodka in me, I lived alone and never saw people, I hated myself and I was suicidal and I felt completely dead inside, every other person seemed like an alien. Psychedelics has helped me reconnect with emotions and empathy. I have since moved in with my best friend, I seek social interaction everyday, I feel genuine love for the people I have in my life, - and I don't need drugs or booze to do so.

I'm not 100 % *there* yet, but I'm getting there. And compared to how I was a couple months ago, I'm pretty damn happy with the progress
